description: Single-line and automatically growing multiline text field.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-textfield label="Single line" placeholder="Type some text..." clearable></tp-textfield>

    <tp-textfield label="Multiline" multiline placeholder="Type some text..." clearable value="An example of text that has already been entered in the field"></tp-textfield>

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: Shows the clear button; it is disabled when empty, readonly or disabled.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the field and its clear button.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label associated with the native input or textarea.

attributes.name: multiline
attributes.description: Uses an automatically growing textarea instead of an input.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name submitted with the containing form; defaults to the initial inline content when omitted.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder shown while the field is empty.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Minimum number of rows in multiline mode.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Clears the field and emits `input`, `change`, and `tp-clear`.

methods.name: focus(options?: FocusOptions): void
methods.description: Focuses the native input or textarea.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when the edited value is committed.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted when the value changes while editing.

events.name: tp-clear
events.description: Emitted after the embedded button clears the value.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-textfield>` element implements the <tp-icon name="textfield" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Text field functionality: single-line and automatically growing multiline text field.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Type or edit text in the field. |
| Using the component | The trailing clear button removes its contents when clearing is available. |
| Using the component | A required-field marker means you must provide a value before submitting the form. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the available controls. |
| Typing | Enter or edit the value using the field controls; read-only and disabled fields cannot be edited. |
| Enter / Space on Clear | Activate the clear button when available. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
